question: How does this deity embody the fruit and seat of eightfold yoga?
premises: The deity is the ground of the fruit of eight-limbed yoga
The deity is seated on an eight-petaled lotus
inference: The deity represents both the attainment and the seat of eightfold yoga.
plain_english: He is the ground of the fruit of eight-limbed yoga and is seated on an eight-petaled lotus.
